solutions.title: Three-family adversarial prompt attack
solutions.summary: The 7th-place Solution partitions essays across three targeted prompt attacks, repeats a selected batch, and uses seeded swaps to stabilize the final private score.

competition.name: LLMs - You Can't Please Them All

preprocessing.text: Neutral random-word sequences and topic-conditioned essay templates form the attack inputs.

inference.text: Rows are partitioned across three prompt-attack families aimed at different judge behaviors.

postprocessing.text: A selected 18-row batch is repeated, then specific essays are swapped before export.

ensembling.text: Three attack families are distributed across the submission rather than relying on one exploit.

solutions.title: Two-stage detector with fold ensemble
solutions.summary: Illustrative object-detection pipeline combining scale-aware augmentation, fold models, test-time augmentation, and weighted box fusion.

validation.text: Stratified group folds keep related images together.

preprocessing.text: Scale-aware crops and color augmentation are applied during training.

model.text: A feature-pyramid detector is trained per fold.

training.text: Fold checkpoints are selected by validation mAP.

inference.text: Multi-scale and flip test-time augmentation produce candidate boxes.

postprocessing.text: Weighted box fusion combines overlapping predictions.

solutions.title: Mask-aware transformer stack
solutions.summary: Illustrative segmentation approach using tiled training, boundary-aware loss, overlapping inference, and connected-component cleanup.

preprocessing.text: Large images are sampled as overlapping tiles.

model.text: A hierarchical transformer encoder feeds a mask decoder.

training.text: Dice and boundary losses are optimized together.

solutions.title: Leakage-safe boosting ensemble
solutions.summary: Illustrative tabular solution centered on time-aware validation, conservative target encoding, and rank-averaged tree models.

validation.text: Purged time folds match the hidden evaluation window.

preprocessing.text: Target encodings are fitted out of fold.

model.text: Gradient-boosted tree families provide complementary predictions.

training.text: Early stopping uses the matching fold only.

inference.text: Fold predictions are averaged per model family.

postprocessing.text: Predictions are converted to within-model ranks.

solutions.title: Spectrogram conformer with crop voting
solutions.summary: Illustrative audio-classification pipeline using log-mel inputs, time-frequency masking, conformer blocks, and crop-level voting.

validation.text: Recording groups remain within a single fold.

model.text: Conformer blocks aggregate local and global acoustic context.

training.text: Time and frequency masks regularize training crops.

inference.text: Multiple temporal crops are evaluated per recording.

postprocessing.text: Crop probabilities are averaged before thresholding.

solutions.title: Temporal fusion with residual blend
solutions.summary: Illustrative forecasting solution combining lag features, a neural temporal model, a tree baseline, and horizon-specific blending.

preprocessing.text: Lag, rolling, and calendar features are generated causally.

model.text: A temporal fusion model is paired with a boosted-tree residual model.

training.text: Models are fitted independently at each origin.

inference.text: Recursive forecasts update permissible lag features.

postprocessing.text: Outputs are clipped to the observed physical range.

ensembling.text: Blend weights vary by forecast horizon.

solutions.title: Dual encoder with cross-encoder rerank
solutions.summary: Illustrative ranking solution using hard-negative mining, dual-encoder retrieval, cross-encoder reranking, and reciprocal-rank fusion.

validation.text: Query groups do not cross validation folds.

preprocessing.text: Near-duplicate documents are grouped before splitting.

model.text: Dual-encoder retrieval feeds a cross-encoder reranker.

training.text: Hard negatives are refreshed between training rounds.

inference.text: The reranker scores the top retrieved candidates.
